claims.text: The Haladin remained in the Forest of Brethil for the duration of the First Age, and in time were known as the House of Haleth.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Silmarillion, "Quenta Silmarillion: Of the Coming of Men into the West"

claims.text:
In The Quenta, Haleth the Hunter was the son of Hador who first appears as one of the Fathers of Men. Later, he appeared as the leader of one of the Three Houses of Men, until his character was reworked into Lady Haleth.
